{{Quote|When I was one of Palpatine's personal guard, back when he was chancellor. Just after the Battle of Coruscant. Lieutenant Shalk and I escorted his party to the Galaxies Opera House.|Halland Goth|<ref name="MOE" />}}
'''Cempo Shalk''' was a [[Gender|male]] member of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]'s personal [[Emperor's Royal Guard|Red Guard]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. In [[19 BBY]], [[Lieutenant]] Shalk and fellow guard [[Halland Goth]] escorted Palpatine and his party to a performance at the [[Galaxies Opera House]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. Shalk stood in Palpatine's private box until the chancellor dismissed the rest of his party to speak with the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], at which point Shalk escorted the others out.

Later that [[Standard year|year]], after the Republic [[Proclamation of the New Order|transitioned]] into the [[Galactic Empire]], [[Galactic Emperor]] Palpatine assigned Shalk, Goth and five other Royal Guards to accompany Skywalker, now known as Darth Vader, to the [[planet]] [[Diso]] in search of a resurrectionist. On Diso, a [[Unidentified man (Adera)|local man]] guided the Imperials to the clearing where the resurrectionist, local [[shaman]] [[Ensoor-Koda-Za]], lived.

When Vader and the guardsman confronted the shaman in his [[Shaman's cave|cave]], the shaman drove the guardsman out with [[fire]] and was presumed [[Death|dead]]; however, he survived and confronted Shalk and his allies once again in the settlement [[Adera]] as they prepared to leave. During the confrontation, Vader used [[the Force]] to rip up much of the surrounding town and Shalk was impaled by a timber stake. He remained in critical condition for the group's entire journey back to Coruscant on an Imperial [[shuttle]], but was kept alive with a [[Medpac|medkit]] and received good care once the trip was complete.

==Biography==
===At the opera===
{{Quote|Palpatine dismissed his party—there was Mas Amedda, and his chief of staff, Sly Moore. And a senator from Sembla, I think. Palpatine sent them away, and Shalk escorted them out.|Halland Goth|<ref name="MOE" />}}
Cempo Shalk was a [[Gender|man]] who, during the [[Republic Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Republic]], served in<ref name="MOE" /> the [[Emperor's Royal Guard|Red Guard]],<ref name="CL">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]''</ref> the personal [[bodyguard]]s of the Republic's leader, [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]. During the [[Clone Wars]]<ref name="MOE" /> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="ROTSDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY]].</ref> Shempo held the rank of [[lieutenant]] and escorted Palpatine and his party to<ref name="MOE" /> a performance of the [[opera]] [[Squid Lake]]<ref name="CGttSWG">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> at the [[Galaxies Opera House]] on the Republic [[capital]] [[Coruscant]]. During the show, Shalk stood at the rear of Palpatine's private box with fellow Red Guard [[Halland Goth]] while Palpatine sat with his chief of staff [[Sly Moore]], [[Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda]], and<ref name="MOE" /> [[Senator]] [[Sweitt Concorkill]].<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

When the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] arrived at the box part way through the performance, Palpatine greeted him and summoned him over. The Supreme Chancellor then dismissed Moore, Amedda, and Concorkill,<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> who Shalk escorted out of the private box, leaving Palpatine, Skywalker, and Goth alone. Shortly after Palpatine and Skywalker's encounter at the opera house, the Clone Wars came to an end and the victorious Republic [[Proclamation of the New Order|transitioned]] into the [[Galactic Empire]] with Palpatine as [[Galactic Emperor]]. Shalk and the other Red Guards became the Emperor's Royal Guard under this new regime, with Goth being appointed their leader.<ref name="MOE" />

===Dispatched to Diso===
{{Quote|The Imperial hierarchy will learn to accommodate you at a level I will determine in the coming days, but the people of Diso exist outside the Empire, for the moment, as they exisited outside the Republic. It is important they understand the might that sits at their border. For this reason, you will be accompanied by my Royal Guard. They will form your retinue. There is strength in numbers, but also in appearances.|Emperor Palpatine|<ref name="MOE" />}}
Later in 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]],<ref name="Date">The events of ''[[Master of Evil]]'' begin during the events of [[Darth Vader (2017) 5|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 5]] and then spans to before the events of [[Darth Vader (2017) 6|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 6]], which corresponds to [[19 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''.</ref> Shalk was one of six royal guards under the command of Goth who the [[Emperor]] assigned to accompany his [[Sith apprentice]], Darth Vader, to the [[planet]] [[Diso]] in the [[Expansion Region]]. After Palpatine informed Vader—who unbeknownsts to the guards was secretly Skywalker—that he would be investigating a supposed "ressurectionist" on Diso, the Emperor summoned Shalk and the other guards with a press of a button on his throne in his office at the pinacle of the [[Imperial Executive Building]] on Coruscant. The [[squad]] then marched into the office and Goth introduced himself to Vader, after which they were soon joined by [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[ISB Supervisor|Supervisor]] [[Korali Desler]], who casually glanced over Shalk and the other guards.<ref name="MOE" />

Vader objected to having guards, but Palpatine dismissed his complaint and so Vader left in silence. Once Vader was gone, the Emperor told Shalk and the others that they were now under Vader's command and dimissed them as well. In the lobby outside the office, Goth ordered the six other guards to head to their [[Royal Guard's barracks|barracks]] and prepare for depature and so Shalk and the others filed away. [[Standard hour|Hours]] later, Shalk and the rest of the squad departed Coruscant with Vader in a [[shuttle]] and made the relatively long journey to the [[Diso system]]. They landed in the [[spaceport]] of [[Adera]], the only settlement of note on Diso, and before they disembarked Vader gave a single order: find the ressurectionist of Diso.<ref name="MOE" />

===Forest guide===
Vader and Goth then remained in Adera's market square waiting while Shalk and the five other Royal Guards began going door to door to question the residents of the town, who had made themselves scarce upon the imposing arrival of the Imperials. The process took longer then Goth had expected and it was late in the [[Local day|day]] when the Royal Guards finally came up with a lead. Two of the guards brought a [[Unidentified man (Adera)|local man]] before Vader who had agreed to guide them to the resurrectionist, who was the local [[shaman]], [[Ensoor-Koda-Za]].<ref name="MOE" />

The guide led Shalk and his comrades in a fairly straight line through the dense [[tree]]s of the ancient woodland that surrounded Adera for over an hour and a half through heavy [[Water|rain]]. When the local finally stopped, Goth signalled Shalk and the others to remain in place before proceeding to the forest's edge with Vader and the guide. Ahead of them lay a large clearing in which the [[shaman's cave]] was located.<ref name="MOE" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Equipment==
At both the opera house<ref name="ROTS" /> and while on Diso, Shalk wore the distinctive red ceremonial robes and cowl-like [[Helmet|mask]] of Palpatine's guard. The uniform was designed for pomp and circumstance and also to elicit fear in those who saw it, but on Diso it proved impractical.<ref name="MOE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cempo Shalk first appeared in the [[2005]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="ROTS" /> The character was first identified in the [[2025]] novel ''[[Master of Evil]]'', by [[Adam Christopher]].<ref name="MOE" /> Christopher suggested that the character was named for his fellow ''[[Star Wars]]'' author [[Chris Kempshall]]. Christopher was also amused to see the character receive a [[Wookieepedia]], a fan-run encyclopedia of the ''Star Wars'' universe.<ref name="Kempshall">{{Bluesky|adamchristopher.me|post/3m5iq6svcds2o|[[Adam Christopher]]|date=2025-11-13|quote=@chriskempshall.bsky.social Hey, fame at last: [Link to Cempo Shalk's Wookiepedia page]|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/DMLAI}}</ref>
